definitions.explanation: The short hairs growing along the edge of the eyelid.

examples.japanese: まつ{毛|げ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。

examples.english: A piece of debris got stuck on my eyelash.

examples.japanese: {付|つ}けまつ{毛|げ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{見|み}せている→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: She's wearing false eyelashes to make her eyes look bigger.

notes:
WRITING: Most commonly written as まつ{毛|げ} or まつげ in hiragana. The full kanji form {睫毛|まつげ} exists but is rarely used in everyday writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- まつ{毛|げ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: to have long eyelashes
- {付|つ}けまつ{毛|げ}: false eyelashes (abbreviated as ⟦つけ→ツケ：29659_tsuke⟧まつげ or つけま)
- まつ{毛|げ}エクステ: eyelash extensions
- まつ{毛|げ}⟦カール→カール：23424_kaaru⟧: eyelash curling
- ビューラー: eyelash curler (from English 'beauler')

CULTURE: Long, thick eyelashes are considered attractive in Japanese beauty standards. Eyelash extensions (まつエク) are a popular beauty service.
